Tree node

Source: R/widget-treeview.R
TreeNode.Rd

A node of a tree shown by tree_view(). See tree_node().

Public fields

label

Text shown for the node.

data

Any R value attached to the node.

id

Optional identifier.

loader

NULL or function(node) returning children, called the first time the node is expanded.

loaded

Has the loader run?

Active bindings

parent

The parent node (read-only).

children

Child nodes (read-only).

expanded

Is the node expanded? (assign to expand / collapse)
